context: M20 o6. A booth at the Iron Gate. Nick on the house phone.

lines.speaker: char.nick_varelas
lines.text: Eleni. My name is on everything. The hotels. The trucks. A lieutenant's boat.

lines.speaker: char.eleni_varelas
lines.text: Of course it is, Nikos. You sign. That's what you're for.

lines.speaker: char.eleni_varelas
lines.text: Read, for once. Then decide what kind of man owns a building with people in it.
